chunks.section: Tax planning vs avoidance vs evasion
chunks.text: Advisory responses should separate lawful tax planning from prohibited tax evasion. When queries seek concealment, refuse and provide compliant alternatives with CA escalation.
chunks.citation_note: Mapped from ICAI module headings and CAPSTONE anti-goals.

chunks.text: For family transfer planning, run a clubbing checklist: transferor/recipient relationship, adequacy of consideration, post-transfer income trail, and specific anti-clubbing triggers under Section 64 provisions.
chunks.citation_note: Derived from live ICAI direct tax study scope.
